## History

In her youth, Mrs. Allan was a dunce at geometry. She moved to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) with her husband, the new minister, and visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea, where she kindly comforted a mortified [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after the girl accidentally served her a layer cake flavored with anodyne liniment. Months later, following the sudden death of [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Allan provided comfort and a listening ear to a grieving [Anne](../character/anne.md) as the young woman processed her loss.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. ## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne.md)

Allan and his wife first met [Anne](../character/anne.md) when she hosted them for tea at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), during which [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally flavored a layer cake with anodyne liniment instead of vanilla. Rather than taking offense, Allan's wife kindly comforted the mortified girl and asked to see her flower garden, establishing them as kindred spirits. [Anne](../character/anne.md) continues to cherish their connection, keeping Allan's wife informed of her academic milestones, including her shared first-place score on the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations.

- Friend of — kindred spirits and minister's wife  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006)</sub>
